title: Streeling review receipt
description: One verdict on one exact text: a module file of streeling/courses/, in one language, at one Git blob. The pages show it only while that file still has that blob.

source.description: The reviewed file, from the repository root: streeling/courses/<department>/<language>/<module>.md, or <module>.<language>.md for a translation. The path names the module and the language.

blob.description: Git blob id of the reviewed text: git rev-parse <commit>:<source>, or git hash-object <source> on a checkout. Any later edit of the file changes it, and the verdict no longer shows.

kind.description: subject: a reviewer who knows the discipline checked the content. language: a fluent speaker checked the language of this text. learner: a learner attempted the module's learner task.

reviewer.description: Who gave the verdict: a name or a pseudonym the reviewer agreed to publish.

date.description: UTC date of the verdict, YYYY-MM-DD.

evidence.description: Where the review itself can be read: an issue, a pull request review, a comment, a file on GitHub.

findings.description: Optional: what the reviewer found, in a few sentences. The pages do not show it; the evidence does.
